svg.aria-label: Topology: a neuro-san lab_assistant on Node A calls the mimOE coordinator over MCP; the coordinator negotiates over the AAOSA mesh with a network agent on Node B, an optional simulation agent on a phone as Node D, and a device agent on Node C; inference runs on Node A, on Node B and on the phone.

svg.text: A neuro-san agent calls the coordinator over MCP; the coordinator negotiates with the specialists over the AAOSA mesh. Node D, a phone, is optional.
